map.：刷单返利（先垫资再要求大额连续刷单→不垫资）、冒充公检法（电话办案要求转“安全: Brushing rebates (front money then demands large repeated orders -> do not front money), impersonating police or prosecutors (phone investigation demanding transfer to a "safe account" -> police have no safe account), fake investment (high return with no risk and urging top-ups -> use proper channels), fake customer service refunds (urging you to share your screen -> operate only on the official platform), pig-butchering scams (be careful as soon as an online romance asks for money -> never transfer or invest), fake loans (any upfront fee is a scam -> legitimate loans charge no upfront fee).
map.：抽到“钓鱼链接”卡片：套路为仿冒银行短信诱导填账号密码，防范要点为不点陌生链接: Drawing a "phishing link" card: the pattern is a fake bank SMS enticing you to enter your account and password; the prevention is not to click unknown links and never give verification codes to anyone. Drawing "a supposed acquaintance borrowing money": a stolen avatar claims an emergency; the prevention is to verify identity by phone or video before transferring.

map.卡片为科普提示，不能替代证据；遇诈骗请保留聊天与转账记录并拨打 96110 反诈: The cards are educational reminders and do not replace evidence; if you are being scammed, keep the chat and transfer records and call the 96110 anti-fraud hotline.
map.为什么强调“不共享屏幕”？: Why Emphasize "Do Not Share Your Screen"?
map.屏幕共享会暴露短信验证码、银行App界面，骗子可据此直接转走资金；客服退款不会要: Screen sharing exposes SMS verification codes and bank app interfaces, which lets a scammer move your money directly; a genuine customer service refund will never ask you to share your screen.
